annotations.title: Comment on your own Facebook or Instagram post

description: Leave a NEW top-level comment on one of the brand’s own posts — a Facebook Page post OR an Instagram post/Reel — as the brand. This is the "link in the first comment" tactic (Facebook suppresses reach on a post with an outbound link in the body, and an Instagram caption link is not clickable), and it is also how you add a pinned clarification, an offer code or a correction without editing the post. It is PUBLIC and posted as the brand: show the user the exact wording and get their go-ahead first. postId comes from list_meta_posts (target:"instagram" for Instagram media ids). INSTAGRAM: text only (Meta documents no attachment on that edge, so attachmentUrl is refused by name), not on live videos; pass account for an Instagram-Login account or one of several. Free.

account.description: INSTAGRAM — which account, an @handle or id from list_connector_accounts("instagram"); needed for an Instagram Login account or when several are linked

attachmentUrl.description: FACEBOOK ONLY — optional public image URL to post as the comment’s attachment (refused on Instagram)

message.description: the comment text. Required unless attachmentUrl is given.

pageId.description: Page id — omit when only one Page is connected

postId.description: the Facebook Page post id or Instagram media id — from list_meta_posts, or returned by post_to_meta

name: comment_on_meta_post
title: Comment on your own Facebook or Instagram post
